title: GitUnstageAllResult
description: Result of the git.unstageAll JSON-RPC method: the fresh post-mutation status. Unstage-all is bare git reset — no HEAD, no pathspec — which is what makes it work on an unborn branch, where git restore --staged fails on an unresolvable HEAD (design D19, measured; no special unborn path is needed or built). It is refused while any entry is conflicted: bare git reset during a conflicted merge deletes .git/MERGE_HEAD, silently aborting the merge. The refusal is a JSON-RPC error carrying git's domain words, which the panel renders as a visible refusal with the reason.
